units.source_text: 鹤川似乎丝毫不为外界的事物所苦恼。

en.t: Tsurukawa seemed not to be troubled in the slightest by anything in the outside world.

units.source_text: 他就像筷子盒里装着的成套筷子一样。

en.t: He was like a matched set of chopsticks lying neatly inside a chopstick case.

units.source_text: 他说：也许一个意想不到的新时代即将到来。

en.t: He said that perhaps an unexpected new age was about to arrive.

units.source_text: 这时，我想起停战后第三天，我上学的时候，就听见大家传说工厂的指导主官把满载一卡车的物资运到自己的私邱。

en.t: At that moment, I remembered how, on the third day after the ceasefire, when I went to school, I had heard everyone saying that the factory's supervising officer had carried a truck fully loaded with supplies to his own private residence.

units.source_text: 士官还公然声称今后我要干黑市买卖了！

en.t: The officer had even openly declared, From now on, I am going into the black-market trade!
